===Lobster pots===
[[File:Caging.png|thumb|300px|This player is using a [[lobster pot]] to catch [[Raw lobster|lobster]]s.]]
[[Raw lobster|Lobster]]s are caught in the sea by using [[lobster pot]]s. When a player has found a [[Fishing spots|fishing spot]], they can then use their lobster pot if the option "cage fishing spot" is available. This is also true for [[Raw Dark Crab|Dark Crabs]], with the only difference being [[Dark Fishing Bait]] must also be in a player's inventory.
